text:
Marta: @cloud-ops heads up — we need quota increases in project `redwood-prod` for a large perf run next week. Primary asks: increase A100 GPU quota in us-west2, bump secondary IP range for prod-subnet, and relax maxPods per node because dual-stack IPv6 is reducing usable pod IPs.
Ben: Can you list exact quota names + numbers you want me to request?
Marta: Sure — current vs requested:
- GPUs (NVIDIA A100) region us-west2: current 16 -> request 60
- Global GPU quota for project: current 40 -> request 120
- Secondary IPs for subnet-us-west2-prod: currently /18 (4096) -> request additional /17 (8192 total usable)
- maxPods per node: default 110 -> we need effective >180 usable pod slots per node because dual-stack assigns v4+v6 addresses in our setup (so requesting policy change or guidance)
Ben: Copy. Who's the cost owner and what's the justification? GCP will ask.
Marta: Justification: running Redwood Optimize end-to-end perf sweep to validate batching + KV cache effectiveness at production scale before Dedicated rollout. Peak expected: ~350 RPS across 4k-token contexts, step tests will spin up ~60 A100s over ~48h windows. Timeline: start 2026-04-10, duration ~2 weeks. Cost owner: infra-budget-qa.
Priya: Quick note on CNI: we're on GKE using VPC-native (alias IP) + Calico for policy. With dual-stack enabled pods currently get v4+v6 which effectively doubles IP consumption. Two options: 1) request much larger secondary ranges, or 2) switch to IPv6-only pod addressing (not currently GA everywhere) or 3) enable pod CIDR packing + larger node sizes. GKE has documented limits for maxPods per node depending on node CIDR size.
Aj: For the GPU nodepool we should consider larger nodes (e.g., 8xA100/96vCPU flavor) and increase `--max-pods-per-node` accordingly. Also ensure device-plugin and kubelet arg `--max-pods` are aligned. Example gcloud snippet we intend to use: 
```
gcloud container node-pools create inference-pool \ 
  --cluster=prod-cluster --region=us-west2 \ 
  --machine-type=n2-highmem-96 \ 
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=8 \ 
  --num-nodes=8 \ 
  --max-pods-per-node=190 \ 
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=4 --max-nodes=32
```
Ben: Keep in mind GKE IP alias secondary range size limits how many pods you can assign per node. If we request a /17 we'll have the headroom for these numbers.
cloud-ops-bot: Quick check — current quotas for `redwood-prod`: A100 (us-west2) = 16, GPUs (global) = 40, subnet-us-west2-prod secondary range = /18 (4096). Link to request: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-prod&filter=accelerator
Ben: I'll open the GCP quota request and include the justification. Also filing an internal infra ticket to change nodepool maxPods and coordinate rollout.
Ben: Jira/Req created: GCP-REQ-12345, internal infra ticket INFRA-8765.
cloud-ops-bot: GCP support case 987654321 opened on behalf of redwood-prod. Expected response 3-5 business days; they may request architecture diagram and exact test schedule.
Marta: Added perf plan and architecture diagram to the Jira and linked it in the GCP form. Also added cost estimate and owner.
Priya: One more: please validate CNI dataplane memory under high packed pod density — Calico IPAM and kube-proxy conntrack could be hotspots. Suggest a canary nodepool to run a stress test before full rollout.
Aj: Agreed — do canary of 2 nodes with same config then scale. Also ensure GPU device-plugin visibility.
Ben: Noted. I'll add a canary step and smoke tests in INFRA-8765.
Marta: Thanks all — please ping here when GCP replies or if they need more detail. :thumbsup:
cloud-ops-bot: will update thread when case moves to 'escalated' or 'need more info'.
